last.verdict: Moderna swung to a $162M profit on international COVID vaccine deliveries and raised its revenue outlook, but the cash jump is mostly borrowed.

takeaways.label: Revenue outlook raised
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue growth is now expected at 15%–25%, up from up to 10%. Third-quarter revenue rose 29% to $1.3B, driven by international COVID vaccine deliveries.

takeaways.label: Profit, but cash is borrowed
takeaways.text: Quarterly net income was $162M versus a $200M loss a year ago. Year-end cash is now seen at $8.1–8.3B, up from $4.7–5.2B, largely from $2.6B net convertible-note proceeds.

takeaways.label: Melanoma shot works
takeaways.text: Phase 3 data for the Moderna-Merck cancer treatment intismeran showed a 42% lower risk of recurrence or death versus Keytruda alone. Regulatory filings are being prepared.

takeaways.label: Flu launch is limited
takeaways.text: The FDA approved its flu vaccine, but approval came after annual contracting, so this season's U.S. launch is limited. The norovirus vaccine's path is unclear.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
